name: Magnesium Oxide Ionic Crystal Lattice (MgO)
semanticDescription: 3D ionic crystal lattice structure of Magnesium Oxide showing alternating Mg²⁺ cations and O²⁻ anions bonded by strong electrostatic forces in a rock-salt cubic arrangement.
simplifications: Ions are shown in ball-and-stick lattice mode to clearly distinguish ionic radii (Mg²⁺ = 72 pm, O²⁻ = 140 pm) and 6:6 octahedral coordination.

interactive_states.label: 2x2x2 Ionic Unit Cell
interactive_states.description: Alternating Mg²⁺ and O²⁻ ions in a face-centered cubic lattice.

interactive_states.label: Coulomb Force Field
interactive_states.description: Visualizes the omnidirectional electrostatic attraction holding the solid crystal together.

cbse_mapping.exam_takeaways: Ionic compounds have high melting and boiling points due to strong inter-ionic electrostatic attractions in the crystal lattice.
